lessons.name: Compare numbers up to 100: word problems

contents.html: Jenny went bird watching. She saw 28 hawks and 24 falcons. Did Jenny see fewer hawks or falcons?
Jenny went bird watching. She saw 28 hawks and 24 falcons. Did Jenny see fewer hawks or falcons?

content.html: 24 is fewer than 28. Jenny saw fewer falcons.

contents.html: There are 23 libraries in John's county. There are more high schools than libraries. How many high schools are there in John's county? Pick a possible answer.
There are 23 libraries in John's county. There are more high schools than libraries. How many high schools are there in John's county? Pick a possible answer.

content.html: Try both answer choices. 25 is more than 23. There are 25 high schools in John's county.

contents.html: In art class, Nate made 4 paintings. He made more drawings than paintings. How many drawings did he make? Pick a possible answer.
In art class, Nate made 4 paintings. He made more drawings than paintings. How many drawings did he make? Pick a possible answer.

content.html: Try both answer choices. 8 is more than 4. Nate made 8 drawings.

contents.html: Tina and Abby caught bugs for a school project. In Tina's backyard, they caught 47 grasshoppers. In a neighbor's yard, they caught another 45 grasshoppers. Did they catch fewer grasshoppers in Tina's backyard or in the neighbor's yard?

Tina and Abby caught bugs for a school project. In Tina's backyard, they caught 47 grasshoppers. In a neighbor's yard, they caught another 45 grasshoppers. Did they catch fewer grasshoppers in Tina's backyard or in the neighbor's yard?

content.html: 45 is fewer than 47. They caught fewer grasshoppers in the neighbor's yard.

contents.html: Abby and her sisters went to a car dealership. They looked at more sports cars than pickup trucks. If they looked at 9 pickup trucks, how many sports cars did they look at? Pick a possible answer.
Abby and her sisters went to a car dealership. They looked at more sports cars than pickup trucks. If they looked at 9 pickup trucks, how many sports cars did they look at? Pick a possible answer.

content.html: Try both answer choices. 10 is more than 9. They looked at 10 sports cars.

contents.html: Colin and Dave made finger puppets together last weekend. Colin made 6 finger puppets. Dave made 7 finger puppets. Who made fewer puppets?
Colin and Dave made finger puppets together last weekend. Colin made 6 finger puppets. Dave made 7 finger puppets. Who made fewer puppets?

content.html: 6 is fewer than 7. Colin made fewer puppets.

contents.html: The zoo has 10 penguins. It also has 13 flamingos. Are there fewer penguins or flamingos at the zoo?
The zoo has 10 penguins. It also has 13 flamingos. Are there fewer penguins or flamingos at the zoo?

content.html: 10 is fewer than 13. There are fewer penguins at the zoo.

contents.html: The hotel has 51 rooms with a view of the river. It has more rooms with a view of the city than with a view of the river. How many rooms in the hotel have a view of the city? Pick a possible answer.
The hotel has 51 rooms with a view of the river. It has more rooms with a view of the city than with a view of the river. How many rooms in the hotel have a view of the city? Pick a possible answer.

content.html: Try both answer choices. 54 is more than 51. The hotel has 54 rooms with a view of the city.

contents.html: Lola and Deb spilled a box of paper clips on the floor. Lola picked up 89 paper clips. Deb picked up 88 paper clips. Who picked up more paper clips?
Lola and Deb spilled a box of paper clips on the floor. Lola picked up 89 paper clips. Deb picked up 88 paper clips. Who picked up more paper clips?

content.html: 89 is more than 88. Lola picked up more paper clips.

contents.html: Pam and her parents drove across the country. They saw 74 cars from Nevada. They saw fewer cars from Colorado than from Nevada. How many cars from Colorado did Pam and her parents see? Pick a possible answer.

Pam and her parents drove across the country. They saw 74 cars from Nevada. They saw fewer cars from Colorado than from Nevada. How many cars from Colorado did Pam and her parents see? Pick a possible answer.

content.html: Try both answer choices. 72 is fewer than 74. They saw 72 cars from Colorado.

contents.html: Harper ate 17 red grapes and 18 green grapes. Did Harper eat more red grapes or green grapes?
Harper ate 17 red grapes and 18 green grapes. Did Harper eat more red grapes or green grapes?

content.html: 18 is more than 17. Harper ate more green grapes.

contents.html: The fruit basket contains fewer pears than apples. If there are 16 apples in the fruit basket, how many pears are there? Pick a possible answer.

content.html: Try both answer choices. 15 is fewer than 16. There are 15 pears in the fruit basket.

contents.html: Pete ate 11 red grapes. He ate more green grapes than red grapes. How many green grapes did Pete eat? Pick a possible answer.
